title: National Conference on Emerging Trends in AI, Quantum Computing & Cyber Forensics
description: Two-day national academic symposium organized by the Post Graduate Department of Computer Science in association with IQAC.
summary: Two-day national academic symposium organized by the Post Graduate Department of Computer Science in association with IQAC.
content: The Post Graduate Department of Computer Science, in collaboration with Internal Quality Assurance Cell (IQAC), cordially invites academicians, research scholars, and industry professionals to the two-day National Conference.
Keynote addresses will be delivered by distinguished scientists from IISc Bangalore, DRDO, and premier IT corporations.
Selected peer-reviewed papers will be published in UGC-CARE and Scopus-indexed research journals.

subEvents.title: Inaugural & Keynote Session: AI & Quantum Computing Paradigms
subEvents.description: Opening addresses by guest scientists from IISc & keynote lectures on quantum neural networks.

subEvents.title: Track Presentations & Cyber Forensics Workshop
subEvents.description: Parallel research paper presentations and hands-on demonstrations of quantum cryptography.

signatory: Head, PG Dept. of Computer Science & IQAC Coordinator

title: Campus Placement Drive 2026 — JK Tyre & IT Corporate Recruiters
description: Campus recruitment drive by JK Tyre & Industries, Infosys, and Banking Corporations for graduating final year students.
summary: Campus recruitment drive by JK Tyre & Industries, Infosys, and Banking Corporations for graduating final year students.
content: The Training and Placement Cell announces the Mega Campus Placement Drive for final year students across B.Sc., B.Com., B.B.A., B.C.A., M.Sc., and M.Com. disciplines.
Selection process consists of Online Aptitude Assessment, Technical Evaluation, Group Discussion, and HR Interview rounds.
Registered candidates must report in formal attire with 3 copies of updated resume, passport photographs, and college ID card.

subEvents.title: Online Aptitude & Technical Screening Rounds
subEvents.description: Standardized computer-based aptitude tests and domain technical evaluation.

subEvents.title: HR Interviews & Offer Letter Distribution
subEvents.description: One-on-one personal HR rounds followed by distribution of letters of intent.

title: PHILOFEST 2026 — Annual Inter-Collegiate Cultural & Literary Fest
description: Over 35 premier institutions competing across 25 dynamic literary, performing arts, debating, and music competitions.
summary: Over 35 premier institutions competing across 25 dynamic literary, performing arts, debating, and music competitions.
content: The Student Welfare Council and Cultural Committee proudly present 'PHILOFEST 2026', a vibrant confluence of student talent, creativity, and inter-collegiate camaraderie.
Events include Western & Classical Music, Street Play, Debate, Fine Arts, Fashion Pageant, Dance Battles, and Quiz Competitions.
Cash prizes, trophies, and certificates of merit will be awarded to all winning contingents.

subEvents.title: Inaugural Ceremony & Battle of the Bands
subEvents.description: Grand opening ceremony followed by inter-collegiate musical ensemble competition.

subEvents.title: Choreography, Street Play & Valedictory Gala
subEvents.description: Thematic dance competitions, street drama finals, and grand award distribution.

title: Annual Athletic Meet & Inter-Departmental Sports Championship 2026
description: Annual Track & Field Athletic Meet and Sports Championship with march-past, track events, and championship trophies.
summary: Annual Track & Field Athletic Meet and Sports Championship with march-past, track events, and championship trophies.
content: The Department of Physical Education invites all staff and students to the Annual Athletic Meet & Sports Championship 2026.
Events include 100m, 200m, 400m, 1500m Sprint, 4x100m Relay, Shot Put, Long Jump, High Jump, and Javelin Throw.
March past contingents from all 24 departments will be evaluated for the Best Contingent Rolling Shield.

subEvents.title: Departmental March Past & Sprint Heats
subEvents.description: Ceremonial parade by 24 departments followed by track qualifying heats.

subEvents.title: Field Finals, Relay & Trophy Presentation
subEvents.description: Final rounds for jump and throw events, 4x100m relay, and championship rolling shield award ceremony.

signatory: Director of Physical Education & Sports Committee
